lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke enters the 'enemy base' and realizes it's just Grocery Outlet after hours.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Wait... this is just... the same store?

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Was the spaceship just... a simulator?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The lights are off, and the store is eerily quiet.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: But the phone still says Professor is here somewhere.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke navigates through the dark aisles.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Luke reaches the back of the store and sees a figure.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: But as Luke approaches, the figure turns around.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: You! You're the person from the cul-de-sac! And the man from the mall! And the helper!

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Who are you? Where's Professor Layton?

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: All in good time, Luke. First, you must pass one final test.

lines.speaker: luke
lines.text: Enough games! Tell me where the Professor is!

lines.speaker: stranger
lines.text: Very well. It's time for the truth.
